why: This file named the quantity a 'recall band', which invited reading it as a range within which a true recall lies. It is not that. It is an assignment-sensitivity envelope: its upper end is what follows from granting every contested assignment without human adjudication. The file also used a 23-code framing in places where the denominator is 21.

retained_for_provenance_only.why_a_band_not_a_point: The blind audit disagreed with the primary evaluator on 7 of 22 audited negatives, finding literal gate-passing participant evidence for codes Gemini marked absent. Disagreements are NOT converted by majority and NOT flipped; they are held as UNRESOLVED. A point estimate would present one evaluator's reading as settled when it is not.
retained_for_provenance_only.strict_precision: NOT_ESTIMABLE — the synthetic present-set is itself disputed
